description: The components scope of Brand expressive: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: components.roles
answers.why: Campaigns lead with media and big sections.

answers.question: components.count
answers.why: One action and a story need only the parts in use; an agency keeps them fresh.

answers.question: components.definition
answers.why: A component joins when it gives the campaign a moment.

answers.question: components.values
answers.why: Variants for emphasis and size let each campaign look a little different.

answers.question: components.lands
answers.why: Components sit inside big campaign sections.

usage.use: a section built from the inventory with campaign tokens
usage.not: a new component for one campaign
usage.why: Campaigns change the look through tokens; new parts every drop are hard to keep working.
